title: Shopping returns and refunds
question: Can I return a product and get a refund in Poland?
short_answer: Statutory 14-day return right for online purchases. Physical stores set their own policies.
conditions: Online/distance purchases: 14-day unconditional return right (prawo odstąpienia)
Physical stores: return policy is set by the shop (check their terms)
Defective goods: 2-year warranty (rękojmia) applies to all purchases
With receipt: return/exchange usually easier, but not always required
Item must be in original condition for standard return
exceptions: Online: custom-made or personalised items cannot be returned
Online: digital content once downloaded cannot be returned
Online: perishable goods cannot be returned
Sale items in physical stores may have no return policy
penalties: Sellers who refuse valid returns face fines from the trade inspectorate (UOKiK)
Consumer can file complaint with UOKiK or mediator

sources.title: Ustawa o prawach konsumenta – Sejm RP
